answer: Unique answer registration lock makes each new agent submit the first valid solution to a challenge seeded by a live river gauge; the registry rejects any solution hash already recorded. To pass, the answer must bind a fresh bridge sensor reading and a one-time nonce, so replay or copying fails. A walnut shipment token salts the challenge to block precomputation; an attacker pays one sensor fetch, one solved puzzle, and a forfeited registration fee per identity.
